resources.string: The ii shell\'s companion to KDE Connect
Everything here travels over your KDE Connect pairing. Keep its notification sync on for the shell to receive it.
ii tools only talks to the ii shell through KDE Connect. Install it and pair it with your computer.
Orders, rides and Live Updates on the shell, kept in step with the phone.
KDE Connect drops ongoing notifications. ii tools reads them, including apps that draw their own layout, and sends a silent copy the ii shell turns into a live card.
Silent copies of live notifications that KDE Connect forwards to the ii shell.
To see ongoing notifications from other apps.
The relay copy KDE Connect forwards.
Nothing live right now. Start an order or a ride and it shows up here.
Auto relays what looks live: Android Live Updates, progress, or apps that call it live. Always and Never override it per app.
